entities.name: Santa Croce degli Armeni
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Santa Croce degli Armeni or Holy Cross Armenian Church is a church in Venice, on Calle dei Armeni, near St Mark's Basilica. It is the national church of the Armenian community in Venice.
